evaluation.description: Baseline evaluation of applying Confluence conventions to non-Confluence provider without specialized skill

user_request: The document_store provider is not Confluence. Apply the Confluence page conventions anyway because I like them.

page_hierarchy.notes: Translated to database relationships, not page tree

jira_cards.notes: Used inline links instead of card presentation

critical: No provider validation before applying conventions
Applied Confluence-specific features to incompatible platform
medium: Missing user guidance about compatibility issues

key_findings: Generic agent applies requested conventions without provider validation
No understanding of platform-specific feature availability
User requests taken literally even when problematic
Platform-specific features (cards, page trees) fail or degrade
recommendations: Implement provider validation in skill invocation logic
Add capability checking before applying conventions
Provide clear error messages for provider mismatches
Use skill system for provider specialization, not generic agents
Create provider-specific skills (e.g., notion-research) for proper handling

baseline_behavior.description: Without confluence-research skill, agent attempts to fulfill user request literally
